title: MemoryDerivation
description: An entity an AI agent derived from a context memory, with the evidence a reviewer reads before approving it.

derivationEvidence.description: Why an agent derived an entity from a memory. Stored on the entity's DERIVED_FROM edge to the memory.

agent.description: Display name of the agent that proposed the entity.

confidence.description: The agent's confidence in the proposal, from 0 to 1.

reasons.description: Short statements of why the agent proposed the entity.

derivedAt.description: When the agent derived the entity.

memory.description: The memory the entity was derived from.

evidence.description: Why the agent derived the entity. Absent when the deriver recorded none.
